shared_elements: radiating/symmetrical fan-like forms (palmette leaves vs. spread wing feathers)
bilateral symmetry about a vertical axis
repeated small rounded units in rows (rosette petals / feather scallops)
justification: A shows purely vegetal/geometric ornament in horizontal registers — a band of rosettes above a band of palmettes above an arcaded scalloped course — while B shows a single frontal bird of prey with outspread wings, talons and a hooked beak, a figural subject entirely absent from A. The only correspondences are generic: bilateral symmetry, disc-like bosses/rosette centres, and rows of repeated rounded units (petals versus feather scallops), which any ornamental tradition could produce independently.
